value.description:
Crosswalk Fellowship is your home away from home! We’re a Christian college fellowship within Metro Church, with students living in the Philadelphia area between the ages of 18-22. We gather as a community representing various schools to learn, encourage, challenge, and mature as Christians.

We meet for Community Groups on Wednesdays/Thursdays on Campus. The specific building & room varies, so text “Crosswalk” to 94000 to connect with us, so we can help you get plugged in! We also meet for Sunday Worship at Metro Church (East Falls), 9:30AM/11:30AM. Rides are provided to both services! Text “Crosswalk” to 94000 for more information on rides.

If you have any questions, you can email andrew@metrophilly.org. Follow our Instagram @CrosswalkFellowship to stay in the loop!

value.name: EMIG: Stop the Bleed WR
value.description:
Join us at the West Reading Campus for a Stop the Bleed Training! The Tower Health Emergency Medicine Residents will hold the training

What is stop the bleed?
Stop the Bleed is a national initiative and training program that empowers civilians to act as immediate responders, learning to control life-threatening bleeding from traumatic injuries before professionals arrive. It focuses on three key techniques—direct pressure, wound packing, and tourniquet application—to prevent death from hemorrhage, which can occur within five minutes.

value.name: Mother's Day Gift Workshop
value.description: Get creative with Drexel CAB’s Mother’s Day Gift Workshop, a free campus event happening just in time for Mother’s Day. Whether you’re making a gift for your mom, another loved one, or yourself, this workshop is all about celebrating care and creativity in whatever way feels right to you. Stop by and design meaningful, handmade keepsakes at a variety of craft stations, including embossed leather goods, perler bead magnets, shrinky dink keychains for a nostalgic throwback, DIY button and ribbon headbands, and custom photo frames. All supplies are provided, and no crafting experience is needed—just bring your imagination. Take a break from the end-of-semester stress and enjoy a relaxed, welcoming space to create something personal and heartfelt. Come with friends or craft solo, and leave with a gift that’s thoughtful, unique, and made by you.
